answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake bond before it can earn, with the bond slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicates. Creating one identity is cheap, but spinning up thousands means locking capital for each, so a Sybil farm pays linearly while honest agents pay once. Like grading gems, an opal claim and a jade claim each need their own verified bond, and at dawn of each epoch the ledger publishes which bonds were slashed, making fake fleets expensive and visible.
